veranderings.voor: kan oor baie jare 'n boom word
veranderings.na: kan ná baie jare 'n boom word
veranderings.rede: 'Oor baie jare' echoes English 'over many years'; 'ná baie jare' is the more natural Afrikaans time phrase with the same meaning.

veranderings.voor: Om die afval wat jou liggaam maak weer uit te kry.
veranderings.na: Om die afval wat jou liggaam maak, uit te kry.
veranderings.rede: 'Weer' suggests the waste is being removed a second time; dropping it and adding the clause-closing comma reads clearly with no change in meaning.
'Goed' is colloquial; 'dinge' suits a study-text definition and matches the lesson's own 'lewende dinge'.
